explanations.explanation: This feature fires whenever the model is inside an elementary‐math problem context—especially number‐theory or arithmetic questions (primality/compositeness tests, divisibility and greatest-common-divisor queries, digit extraction, rounding, etc.).

This neuron fires on English “little” words and punctuation—auxiliaries (be, is, might), infinitival to, negators (not/’t), short conjunctions/prepositions (if, to) and commas—i.e. closed‐class function tokens that mark syntax rather than carry lexical content.
